tasks.short: Forecast water demand from gathered use data.

steps.what: Gather water use data for the demand forecast.
Analyze the use series and forecast demand.
Judge which demand shifts are real.
File the water demand forecast.

loop.output: Filed forecast with horizon, figure and the shifts kept
loop.check: Engineer checks each figure against the sheet
loop.stop: One draft; a shift the judgement rejected is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The file must state the horizon, not only a single number

tasks.design: Meter and connection data load into {BI} without a fresh copy. The forecast formula runs in {SPREADSHEET}. The engineer still judges which shifts are real, and files the forecast only after that judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: Use data were copied into a workbook once a year, so a break in demand was seen late.
tasks.enabler_now: A stable meter export can feed the formula. Deciding that a shift is real stays.
tasks.still_hard: A factory opening or a meter fault that the history treats as growth.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer knows which change is outside the series.

ambition.what: Refresh the demand forecast every month from meters, not only in the annual plan.

tasks.altitude: Judgement of shifts stays. The engineer can refuse to file a forecast with a broken month still inside it.

reach.task: Explain a step change in a large user's consumption
reach.learn: Which industrial changes are planned and should enter the forecast

evidence.claim: A solver or a price can fill a number; the engineer still judges whether the case is credible.
A demand series can be forecast from meters; a break in the series is not automatic growth.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from meter data to a filed demand forecast. Building the capacity scheme is out of scope.
Test the {OPS_SYSTEM} export and a native {BI} series before custom code.
Structured fields are connection, month, volume and forecast horizon. Meters produce volume. Fallback: a missing month is marked incomplete and kept out of the filed figure.
Judging a shift is not the formula.
unknowns: Whether large users are metered monthly.
research_questions: Which shifts need a call to the user before they are treated as growth?

incremental.description: Fix meter mappings and seasonal factors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Complete meters save the extract and most of the formula. Real shifts stay a judgement. The low case is a year of missing or replaced meters.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study environmental impacts of water and wastewater works.

steps.what: Scope the environmental impact studies.

loop.output: Scope note: receptor, pathway and study question
loop.check: Engineer checks each receptor against the map
loop.stop: One pass; a receptor with no pathway stays open
loop.why_not_simpler: Briefs name impacts in prose, not as a scope table

steps.what: Survey the water and wastewater sites in the field.
Ecologist surveys habitats named in the scope.
Rate the impact on treatment and distribution.
Judge which environmental impact is significant.
Issue the environmental impact studies.

loop.input: Significance judgement and the impact sheet
loop.output: Issue stating each significant impact and its evidence
loop.check: Engineer checks every rated impact against the sheet
loop.stop: One draft; an impact the judgement did not call significant is removed from that list
loop.why_not_simpler: The issue is a filing, so it cannot add a conclusion the field notes do not support

tasks.design: Receptors are listed from the brief, and rated impacts are calculated in {SPREADSHEET} from flows and notes. The engineer still surveys the water and wastewater sites, and an ecologist surveys habitats. The study is issued to the agency only after the engineer checks significance.
tasks.previous_blocker: Each impact study restated receptors and mixed field notes with old conclusions.
tasks.enabler_now: A scope table and a rating sheet can be prepared before the write-up. Significance and the field survey stay.
tasks.still_hard: An impact that scores low and is still unacceptable on the ground.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer has seen the site and will not file a significance the notes do not support.
tasks.altitude: Field surveys stay. The engineer can withhold an issue that names an impact with no evidence.

reach.task: Describe the same site's building impact
reach.learn: Which receptors the building study and the water study must not contradict

evidence.claim: The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
An impact rating can be calculated from flows; calling it significant is a judgement the engineer signs.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from the project brief to the issued impact study. Securing the permit decision is the agency's work.
Test {DOCS} scope fields and {SPREADSHEET} ratings before custom code.
Structured fields are receptor, pathway, flow change and rating. The project brief produces the works list. Fallback: a receptor found in the field is added and marked as a site finding.
Surveying the site is physical work.
unknowns: Which impacts the authority treats as significant by rule.
Whether ecology is in this contract.
research_questions: Which studies need a season of data before a significance can be issued?

already_counted.description: Judging significance the rating does not settle

incremental.description: Keep receptor types aligned with the authority's list

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A brief with a clear works list saves the scope extract and the rating arithmetic. Surveys and significance stay. The low case is a site that must be walked in a particular season.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Analyze efficiency of dams, gates, canals, pipes and penstocks.

steps.what: Collect operating records for the delivery structures.
Calculate head loss for pipes, canals and penstocks.
Inspect dams, tainter gates and cofferdams.
Judge the efficiency loss and its cause.
Report the delivery efficiency findings.

loop.output: Report naming the structure, the loss and the cause
loop.check: Engineer checks the loss against the sheet
loop.stop: One draft; a cause not in the notes is removed
loop.why_not_simpler: The report must separate a calculation from what was seen

tasks.design: Operating records feed a head-loss calculation in {SPREADSHEET} for pipes, canals and penstocks. The engineer still inspects dams, tainter gates and cofferdams. The finding is reported only after the calculated loss and the inspected cause are checked against each other.
tasks.previous_blocker: Geometry and logs were retyped, and some efficiency claims were made without a visit.
tasks.enabler_now: Head loss can be calculated from geometry and flow. The cause of a loss, and the inspection, stay.
tasks.still_hard: A head loss that is real on paper and is actually a stuck gate or a damaged cofferdam.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer has seen the structure and will not blame the wrong part.

ambition.what: Inspect a delivery structure before an efficiency project is recommended for it.

tasks.altitude: Inspections stay. The engineer can withhold a finding that has a loss and no inspected cause.

reach.task: Assess a gate or penstock machine for wear
reach.learn: Which losses are mechanical condition rather than hydraulic shape

evidence.claim: A solver or a price can fill a number; the engineer still judges whether the case is credible.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
Head loss is a calculation; the condition of a dam, gate or cofferdam is an inspection.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from operating records to an efficiency finding. Structural safety certification of a dam is out of scope.
Test native {SPREADSHEET} formulas and the {OPS_SYSTEM} export before custom code.
Structured fields are structure, flow, geometry, calculated loss and inspected condition. Logs produce flow. Fallback: a missing geometry is measured or marked unknown, and the loss is not reported.
Inspecting dams and gates is physical work.
unknowns: Which structures the engineer is allowed to approach.
Whether cofferdams are temporary works in this job.
research_questions: Which findings need a dam-safety specialist before they are reported?

already_counted.description: Judging cause when the sheet and the inspection disagree

incremental.description: Keep geometry and loss formulas current for each structure type

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Structures with known geometry save the record pass and the head-loss sum. Inspection and cause stay. The low case is a dam or gate that must be seen before any number is trusted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Model rivers, floodplains, coastlines and wetlands.

steps.what: Assemble boundaries for the surface water resources.

loop.output: Boundary set: inflow, level, downstream condition
loop.check: Engineer checks each inflow against the gauge
loop.stop: One pass; an inflow without a gauge period is blank
loop.why_not_simpler: Gauge files and terrain notes do not share one boundary table

steps.what: Set the mathematical modeling approach for rivers.
Run scenarios for floodplains and the coastlines.
Compare results with gauged flows in the rivers.
Interpret what the water resources model means.
Issue the mathematical modeling note.

loop.output: Model note with scenario, fit and the limit of use
loop.check: Engineer checks the fit against the comparison
loop.stop: One draft; a scenario that failed the gauge check is marked not for use
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must state the limit of the model, not only the map

tasks.design: Gauge and terrain data become a boundary set. The engineer chooses the modeling approach for rivers, then scenarios for floodplains and coastlines run in the model. Results are compared with gauged flows before the engineer interprets them. The note is issued only with that limit of use.
tasks.previous_blocker: Boundaries were rebuilt by hand, and a scenario was sometimes described before it was compared with a gauge.
tasks.enabler_now: A scenario can be run and compared once boundaries exist. Choosing the approach and interpreting the result stay.
tasks.still_hard: A stable run that still does not represent a wetland or a coast the gauge does not see.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer sets what the model is allowed to be used for.

ambition.what: Reject a scenario that misses the gauged flow before anyone interprets it as a flood or coastal result.

tasks.altitude: Approach and interpretation stay. The engineer can mark a scenario not for use when the gauge comparison fails.

reach.task: Provide terrain and water-level control for a model
reach.learn: Which control is too sparse for a floodplain or a coastline

evidence.claim: A solver or a price can fill a number; the engineer still judges whether the case is credible.
The signing engineer stays responsible for what is issued.
Running a scenario is not evidence that the model fits the river.

assumptions: Focal role is the water engineer. Boundary: from gauges and terrain to an issued modeling note. Designing the flood works is out of scope.
Test the model's native boundary tables before custom code.
Structured fields are inflow, level, downstream condition, scenario name and gauge fit. Gauges produce inflow. Fallback: a blank inflow blocks that boundary.
Choosing the approach is a judgement, not a template.
unknowns: Whether underground water is in this model or a separate one.
Which gauges are long enough to compare.
research_questions: Which wetlands or coasts have no gauge and need a different check?

already_counted.description: Interpreting results the gauge comparison leaves open
Checking the issued fit and limit of use

incremental.description: Keep scenario names and boundary defaults from being reused blindly

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A gauged river with a stable mesh saves the boundary extract and the scenario runs. The approach, a poor fit and the interpretation stay. The low case is a wetland or coast with no gauge.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Demand forecasts, impact studies, structure inspections and resource models stay under the engineer's judgement. Meter loads and scenario runs take less hand copying.
reach: Mechanical engineers on gates and penstocks
skills_to_grow: Filing a forecast only after a real shift is separated from a meter fault
Inspecting a structure before an efficiency project
Rejecting a scenario that misses the gauge
role.ambitious_version: Demand can be refreshed every month, and a flood or coastal scenario that misses the gauge is not interpreted as a result.
